top_signals.title: Oil prices jump more than 7% after Trump says U.S. will hit Iran hard
top_signals.summary: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UBS CEO says the AI pullback is healthy — but there’s a bigger risk investors should watch
top_signals.summary: The Swiss banking gian reported pre-tax profits of $3.6 billion for the quarter, as CEO Sergio Ermotti warned of geopolitical volatility ahead.

top_signals.title: CAVU Consumer Partners Co-Founders on Brand Building
top_signals.summary: CAVU Consumer Partners Co-Founders Brett Thomas and Rohan Oza look to Millennials and Gen Z's drive for a healthier lifestyle as the foundation of their venture and brand building with companies such as Whoop, Skinny Dipped and The Farmer's Dog. They speak to Romaine Bostick and Emily Graffeo on Bloomberg's 'The Close.' (Source: Bloomberg)
